SourceFile
  QualifiedPackage nativelink.gcruntime
  public fun preserve<T>(marker: T, text: String): String
    @Unsafe block
      val handle
        Call getGcHandle
          Var text
      Call gcCollect
      val restored
        Call releaseGcHandle
          Var handle
      val pinned
        Call pin
          Var restored
      Call gcCollect
      return
        Call unpin
          Var pinned
